summary: DGX Spark (GB10, linux/arm64): a dgx-spark hardware profile, two-box presets for GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8 Flash Next, multi-node options, and an arm64 image built for every beta release
compatibility: No change on linux/amd64 images. DGX Spark presets need the -spark image, one container per box with NODE_RANK and MASTER_ADDR, and Docker's seccomp filter disabled for io_uring. Research-only.
details: PRESET=glm53-dgx-spark-x2: TP2 over two boxes' RoCE link, the NVFP4-MTP Spark checkpoint, 351,730 KV tokens, about 30 tok/s for one request (lil-bench C1 32.6, C2 52.0, prefill 8k 1,955 tok/s).
PRESET=qwen38-dgx-spark-x2: TP2 over two boxes, 3.39M KV tokens, about 50 tok/s for one request.
NNODES, NODE_RANK, MASTER_ADDR and MASTER_PORT place one tensor-parallel group across machines; ranks above 0 run headless.
The DGX Spark image is published as <channel>-spark-<date>-<id> with the karmic-kraken-beta-spark alias, built from the same component commits as the amd64 image.
